up: Show the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4296802. The output should include the compound's ChEMBL ID, its canonical SMILES, and for each activity measurement the activity ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, and pchembl value. Include all results from this assay without any additional filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.activity_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296802';
